cohort: Female patients of child-bearing age (above 18 years) with chronic pancreatitis (CP) (n=46) compared to age-matched controls from a low-risk pregnancy group (n=115)
finding: Chronic pancreatitis (CP) was not associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, and there was a trend toward improvement in CP clinical symptoms during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were compared between patients with chronic pancreatitis and controls, but no conclusions were made about the impact of mode of delivery.
